bead.title: Build async SQLite checkpoint store
bead.description: Add the async SQLite logical checkpoint implementation. In-scope files: crates/pqueue-sqlite/src/relational.rs, crates/pqueue-projection/src/lib.rs, focused sqlite tests. The worker consumes committed object-log entries in order, applies a batch to SQLite in one transaction, writes logical high-water last in the same transaction, persists idempotency/outcome rows through that high-water, and records object-log lineage metadata. Distinguish logical high-water from SQLite WAL checkpointing. Out of scope: server runtime configuration.
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite hybrid_async_checkpoint -- --nocapture` passes.
2. `cargo test -p pqueue-projection projection_image -- --nocapture` passes.
3. `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite sqlite_projection_image -- --nocapture` passes.
4. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
